# Statistical modelling
```{r}
# Gene expression
dge_btm_process_genes_diff_bygene = readRDS(here("tables", "human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_degs_all_immune_nonimmune.rds"))
dge_btm_process_genes_diff_bygene_clean = dge_btm_process_genes_diff_bygene %>% 
  filter(gene_set == "All genes", comparison == "Human vs. Mouse") %>% 
  filter(pathogen_mouse != "DMD") %>% 
  select(treatment = treatment_human, pathogen = pathogen_human, timepoint_comparison, hgnc_symbol = human_symbol, 
         mean_log2fc_diff, weight_se_inverse_combined) %>% 
  

#LEGs
all_human_mouse_gsea_btm_results_core_joined = readRDS(file = here("tables", "all_human_mouse_gsea_btm_results_core_joined.rds"))
gsea_btm_legs_clean =
  all_human_mouse_gsea_btm_results_core_joined %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  select(pathogen, timepoint_comparison, hgnc_symbol = gene, status) %>% 
  distinct()

#Merge gene expression with LEGs classification
gsea_btm_legs_dge_stats = gsea_btm_legs_clean %>% 
  full_join(dge_btm_process_genes_diff_bygene_clean,
            by = join_by(pathogen, timepoint_comparison, hgnc_symbol)) %>% 
  mutate(status = if_else(is.na(status), "Not LEG", status))

#Filter timepoints
dge_btm_process_genes_diff_bygene_clean_filtered = 
  dge_btm_process_genes_diff_bygene_clean %>% 
  inner_join(
    gsea_btm_legs_clean %>%
      select(pathogen, timepoint_comparison) %>% distinct(),
    by = join_by(pathogen, timepoint_comparison)
  )


#Protein identity
alignments_human2mouse_all = readRDS(file = here("tables", "alignments_human2mouse_all.rds"))

#Distance
human_mouse_cds_distance = readRDS(file = here::here("tables", "human_mouse_cds_distance.rds"))

#Transcription factors
gene_tf_shared_unique = readRDS(file = here("tables", "gene_tf_shared_unique.rds"))

#BTMs annotation
btm_annotation_genes <- read_csv(here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv")) %>% 
  select(hgnc_symbol = symbol, process, group, subgroup) %>% 
  distinct()

btm_annotation_genes_wide = btm_annotation_genes %>% 
  select(hgnc_symbol, group) %>% 
  group_by(hgnc_symbol, group) %>% 
  summarise(n = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = group,
              values_from = n) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("hgnc_symbol") %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  replace(is.na(.), 0) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("hgnc_symbol")

```


```{r}
# #CREs for LEGs and not-LEGS, with gene expression stats and protein AA identity%
# cres_type_homology_comparison_dge_legs_stats = readRDS(file = here("tables", "cres_type_homology_comparison_dge_legs_stats.rds"))



# #CREs (all genes)
cres_type_homology_comparison = readRDS(file = here("tables", "cres_type_homology_comparison.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(type_mouse = if_else(is.na(type_mouse), "Unknown", type_mouse),
         subtype_mouse = if_else(is.na(subtype_mouse), "Unknown", subtype_mouse),
         match_cretype = if_else(is.na(match_cretype), "Unknown", match_cretype),
         match_cresubtype = if_else(is.na(match_cresubtype), "Unknown", match_cresubtype),) %>% 
  group_by(hgnc_symbol, type_human) %>% 
  mutate(n_cat = if_else(n_cat == 0, NA, n_cat)) %>% 
  fill(n_cat, .direction = "downup")

cres_type_homology_comparison_clean = cres_type_homology_comparison %>% 
  select(hgnc_symbol, type_human, subtype_human, match_cretype, match_cresubtype,
         # n_cat, 
         n_total_cre_type_human, n_total_cre_subtype_human, pct_same_cre_type, pct_same_cre_subtype, 
         # match_homology_group, pct_homology
         ) %>% 
  distinct()

#Pivot wider
cres_type_homology_comparison_clean_wide = 
  cres_type_homology_comparison_clean %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = c(hgnc_symbol),
    names_from  = c(type_human, subtype_human, match_cretype, match_cresubtype),
    values_from = c(n_total_cre_type_human, n_total_cre_subtype_human, pct_same_cre_type, pct_same_cre_subtype),
    names_sep   = "_"
  ) %>%  
  column_to_rownames("hgnc_symbol") %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
   #Fill post-pivot NAs with 0 for numeric features
  replace(is.na(.), 0) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("hgnc_symbol")


```


```{r}
#Merge
human_mouse_parameters_values = 
  #Annotate with CDS distance (Kimura)
  human_mouse_cds_distance %>% select(hgnc_symbol, dist_k80) %>% 
  #Annotate with AA identity %
  inner_join(alignments_human2mouse_all,
             by = join_by("hgnc_symbol" == "gene")) %>% 
  #Annotate with BTMs 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes_wide,
             by = "hgnc_symbol") %>% 
  #Annotate with TFs
  inner_join(gene_tf_shared_unique,
             by = join_by("hgnc_symbol" == "gene")) %>% 
  #Annotate with CRES
  inner_join(cres_type_homology_comparison_clean_wide,
             by = join_by(hgnc_symbol)) %>% 
  #Annotate with gene expression
  inner_join(dge_btm_process_genes_diff_bygene_clean_filtered,
             by = join_by(hgnc_symbol)) %>% 
  # Step 3: Define Target Variables for Logistic and Linear Regression
  dplyr::mutate(
  # # Target for Logistic Regression (1 = Shared, 0 = Not Shared)
  # status_bin = factor(dplyr::if_else(status == "Shared", "Shared", "Not_Shared"), levels = c("Shared", "Not_Shared")),
  # Target for Linear Regression (Absolute Log2FC divergence magnitude)
  abs_log2fc_diff = abs(mean_log2fc_diff)
) %>% 
  select(treatment:abs_log2fc_diff, hgnc_symbol, everything(),
         -mean_log2fc_diff)
  

#Save
human_mouse_parameters_values %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "human_mouse_statsmodelling_parameters_values.rds"))


human_mouse_parameters_values

```




Option with status
```{r}
####################### OPTION WITH STATUS
# Prepare master wide features dataset per gene locus
genes_features_master = human_mouse_parameters_values %>%
  # Filter missing identities to ensure clean modeling data
  tidyr::drop_na(identity_human2mouse, status, type_mouse) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    hgnc_symbol, treatment, pathogen, status,
    type_human, subtype_human, match_homology_group, identity_human2mouse, mean_log2fc_diff,
    n_total_cre_type_human, n_cat, pct_same_cre_type, pct_same_cre_subtype, pct_homology
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(hgnc_symbol, pathogen, type_human, subtype_human, match_homology_group) %>%

  # Step 1: Pivot all required features (counts and percentages) to wide format
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = c(hgnc_symbol, treatment, pathogen, status, identity_human2mouse, mean_log2fc_diff),
    names_from  = c(type_human, subtype_human, match_homology_group),
    values_from = c(n_total_cre_type_human, n_cat, pct_same_cre_type, pct_same_cre_subtype, pct_homology),
    names_sep   = "_"
  ) %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%

  # Step 2: Fill post-pivot NAs with 0 for numeric features and "0" for n_cat categorical features
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      .cols = tidyselect::where(is.numeric) & !c(identity_human2mouse, mean_log2fc_diff),
      .fns  = ~ tidyr::replace_na(., 0)
    ),
    dplyr::across(
      .cols = tidyselect::contains("n_cat"),
      .fns  = ~ tidyr::replace_na(as.character(.), "0")
    )
  ) %>%

  # Step 3: Define Target Variables for Logistic and Linear Regression
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Target for Logistic Regression (1 = Shared, 0 = Not Shared)
    status_bin = factor(dplyr::if_else(status == "Shared", "Shared", "Not_Shared"), levels = c("Shared", "Not_Shared")),
    # Target for Linear Regression (Absolute Log2FC divergence magnitude)
    abs_log2fc_diff = abs(mean_log2fc_diff)
  )


genes_features_master 


human_mouse_parameters_values %>%
  # Filter missing identities to ensure clean modeling data
  tidyr::drop_na(identity_human2mouse, type_mouse) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    hgnc_symbol, treatment, pathogen,
    type_human, subtype_human, match_homology_group, identity_human2mouse, mean_log2fc_diff,
    n_total_cre_type_human, n_cat, pct_same_cre_type, pct_same_cre_subtype, pct_homology
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(hgnc_symbol, pathogen, type_human, subtype_human, match_homology_group) %>%

  # Step 1: Pivot all required features (counts and percentages) to wide format
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = c(hgnc_symbol, treatment, pathogen,  identity_human2mouse, mean_log2fc_diff),
    names_from  = c(type_human, subtype_human, match_homology_group),
    values_from = c(n_total_cre_type_human, pct_same_cre_type, pct_same_cre_subtype, pct_homology),
    names_sep   = "_"
  ) %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%

  # Step 2: Fill post-pivot NAs with 0 for numeric features and "0" for n_cat categorical features
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      .cols = tidyselect::where(is.numeric) & !c(identity_human2mouse, mean_log2fc_diff),
      .fns  = ~ tidyr::replace_na(., 0)
    ),
    dplyr::across(
      .cols = tidyselect::contains("n_cat"),
      .fns  = ~ tidyr::replace_na(as.character(.), "0")
    )
  ) %>%

  # Step 3: Define Target Variables for Logistic and Linear Regression
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Target for Linear Regression (Absolute Log2FC divergence magnitude)
    abs_log2fc_diff = abs(mean_log2fc_diff)
  )

```

# PIPELINE 1: LOGISTIC REGRESSION (Classify Shared vs Not-Shared LEGs)
```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# PIPELINE 1: LOGISTIC REGRESSION (Classify Shared vs Not-Shared LEGs)
# ==============================================================================

# --------
# Configure logistic regression specification and recipe
# --------
logistic_spec <- logistic_reg() %>%
  parsnip::set_engine("glm") %>%
  parsnip::set_mode("classification")

logistic_recipe <- recipes::recipe(status_bin ~ ., data = genes_features_master) %>%
  # Preserve metadata columns by assigning them to an "id" role (they won't be used as predictors)
  recipes::update_role(hgnc_symbol, treatment, pathogen, status, abs_log2fc_diff, 
                       new_role = "id") %>%
  # Convert n_cat categorical variables into dummy binaries for glm
  recipes::step_dummy(recipes::all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
  # Remove zero-variance predictors
  recipes::step_zv(recipes::all_predictors()) %>%
  # Scale and center all numeric predictor metrics (percentages and raw counts)
  recipes::step_normalize(recipes::all_numeric_predictors())

# --------
# Fit logistic workflow and extract engine
# --------
logistic_fit <- workflows::workflow() %>%
  workflows::add_recipe(logistic_recipe) %>%
  workflows::add_model(logistic_spec) %>%
  workflows::fit(data = genes_features_master)

# Extract native GLM object for direct diagnostics
logistic_glm_engine <- extract_fit_engine(logistic_fit)

# -> Example direct analysis via pROC
genes_features_master$prob_shared <- predict(logistic_glm_engine, type = "response")
roc_obj <- pROC::roc(genes_features_master$status_bin, genes_features_master$prob_shared, levels = c("Not_Shared", "Shared"))
cat("Logistic AUC:", round(pROC::auc(roc_obj), 3), "\n")

# -> Example direct analysis via broom
logistic_or_table <- broom::tidy(logistic_glm_engine, 
                                 exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE)
```

# PIPELINE 2: LINEAR REGRESSION (Predict Log2FC Divergence Magnitude)
```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# PIPELINE 2: LINEAR REGRESSION (Predict Log2FC Divergence Magnitude)
# ==============================================================================

# --------
# Configure linear regression specification and recipe
# --------
linear_spec <- linear_reg() %>%
  set_engine("lm") %>%
  set_mode("regression")

linear_recipe <- recipes::recipe(abs_log2fc_diff ~ ., data = human_mouse_parameters_values) %>%
  recipes::update_role(hgnc_symbol, treatment, pathogen, timepoint_comparison, new_role = "id") %>%
  recipes::step_dummy(recipes::all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
  recipes::step_zv(recipes::all_predictors()) %>%
  recipes::step_normalize(recipes::all_numeric_predictors())

# --------
# Fit linear workflow and extract engine
# --------
linear_fit <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(linear_recipe) %>%
  add_model(linear_spec) %>%
  fit(data = human_mouse_parameters_values)

# Extract native LM object for direct diagnostics
linear_lm_engine <- extract_fit_engine(linear_fit)

# Example direct analysis via broom
linear_coefficients <- broom::tidy(linear_lm_engine, conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = 0.95) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(
    # Format term names for publication readiness
    term_clean = term %>%
      stringr::str_replace_all("^n_total_cre_type_human_", "Count: ") %>%
      stringr::str_replace_all("^pct_same_cre_type_", "% Same Type: ") %>%
      stringr::str_replace_all("^pct_same_cre_subtype_", "% Same Subtype: ") %>%
      stringr::str_replace_all("^pct_homology_", "% Homology: ") %>%
      stringr::str_replace_all("_", " ")
  ) %>% 
  arrange(-estimate)

# Save
saveRDS(linear_lm_engine, file = here::here("tables", "linear_lm_engine.rds"))
saveRDS(linear_coefficients, file = here::here("tables", "linear_lm_engine_coefficients.rds"))
```



### Assess

```{r fig.height=20, fig.width=10}



forest_plot_linear <- linear_coefficients %>%
  mutate(term_clean = fct_inorder(term_clean)) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(
    x    = estimate,
    y    = term_clean,
    xmin = conf.low,
    xmax = conf.high
  ) +
  # Reference line at zero effect
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.6) +
  # Confidence intervals (horizontal error bars)
  geom_errorbarh(height = 0.2, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  # Estimate point markers
  geom_point(aes(color = p.value <= 0.05), size = 2.5) +
  # Custom colors for statistical significance
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = "#E64B35FF", "FALSE" = "gray60"),
    labels = c("TRUE" = "p <= 0.05", "FALSE" = "p > 0.05")
  ) +
  labs(
    x     = expression("Standardized Effect Size (" * beta * ")"),
    y     = "Predictor Variable",
    color = "Significance",
    title = "Linear Regression: Predictors of |ΔLog2FC|"
  ) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 9)
  )

# Render plot output
print(forest_plot_linear)

```
